narration.prompt: [low, calm] I was babysitting twins. They were asleep upstairs, and the monitor was on the couch beside me. [long pause] [quietly] The sound lights started jumping. Up there, nothing was moving. And the voice was right up against the microphone. [long pause] [shaken] I panned the camera to the door, and back. Something tall was bent over the crib, looking down at them. [long pause] [breathless] I ran up and hit the light. Nobody. They were both asleep. [short pause] [whispers] Then I looked at the monitor in my hand.
narration.takes_note: both takes (522 credits each); take 1 used (31.8 s raw; inner pauses capped at 0.22 s; no tempo change), take 2 kept

speaker.prompt: [whispering, very close, slow] Shhhh... They're sleeping. [short pause] Don't come up.
speaker.takes_note: both takes (86 credits each); take 1 used

monitor-hiss.prompt: The small speaker of a cheap baby monitor in a quiet room: a soft steady radio hiss with faint digital crackle and the occasional low squelch, an empty nursery heard through it, no voices, no music.

winter-house.prompt: A quiet suburban living room on a winter night: a furnace humming through the vents, wind pressing on the windows, the house creaking with the cold, a refrigerator far off. No voices, no music, no TV.

pan-motor.prompt: A tiny plastic camera motor panning, a thin electric whirr and gear clicks, stopping, then whirring back the other way and stopping. Close, small.

feedback.prompt: Piercing audio feedback squeal from a baby monitor brought into the same room as its camera, rising fast into a shriek then cutting off. Horror stinger.

stairs-run.prompt: Someone running up a carpeted wooden staircase in a house, fast heavy footsteps, a creaking step, panting breath, then stopping at the top.

door-light.prompt: A bedroom door pushed open fast, the handle hitting the wall, then a plastic light switch snapped on. Close, indoors.

static-burst.prompt: A sudden harsh burst of digital video static and signal breakup from a small speaker, a crunching glitch hit that cuts off sharply. Horror jump scare.

nursery-drone.prompt: A dark ambient horror bed: a soft detuned toy-like glass tone held under a low breathing pad, cold and empty, slowly pulsing, no melody, no percussion.
